newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND'S PABIANICE TO ISSUE PLN 5 MLN MUNI BONDS.
newsitem.headline: POLAND'S PABIANICE TO ISSUE PLN 5 MLN MUNI BONDS.

text.p: The central Polish town of Pabianice will privately place five million zlotys worth of municipal in two tranches later this year to pay for new buses, a city official said on Thursday.

Tadeusz Fogiel, spokesman for the town's president, said the bonds will have one, two and three years to maturity and will carry a coupon of the 52-week T-bill plus 0.5 percent, 0.7 percent and 0.9 percent respectively.
The agent of the issue is the Polish Investment Bank (PBI).
The first 3.3 million zloty tranche will be sold by June 30 and the second by September 30. -Warsaw Newsroom +4822 653 9700
